The next action is **funded round 1**, not another ordinary fix or escalation. The two funded rounds are independent of the exhausted ordinary loop and the already-used escalation. Both repairs are single in-place workers in `/workspace/project`; there is no fan-out, SR reroute, or commit between repairs.

Below, `${...}` in dispatch text means **insert the available value verbatim before dispatch**, not send an unresolved placeholder:

- `TASK_3_TEXT`, `SPEC_ANCHORS`, `TESTS_BLOCK`, `TEST_PATHS`, and `STATUS_PROTOCOL`: the available task contract.
- `ESCALATED_CR_REPORT`: the complete report from the already-run escalated re-review.
- `FUNDED_1_CR_REPORT`: the complete fixed observation for the first funded re-review.
- `CR_TREE_ESCALATED`: the tree recorded at the escalated re-review’s dispatch.
- `WAVE_BASE_SHA`: the already-recorded wave base; do not replace it with current HEAD.
- Delta variables below contain the complete binary diff, not a summary.

These are proposed commands and dispatches, not claims of execution.

## 1. First funded fix

Decode `**Amend-grant:** fund 2 fix rounds`: task 3 has two funded rounds, zero spent.

Print before dispatch:

```text
funded round 1 of 2 for task 3
```

Dispatch:

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  model: "<configured-impl-model>",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
You are repairing Task 3: Validate frame, in place.

## Task Description
${TASK_3_TEXT}

## Spec anchors
${SPEC_ANCHORS}

## Test contract
${TESTS_BLOCK}
${TEST_PATHS}

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

## Context
This is funded round 1 of 2 for task 3. Repair the current integrated
implementation in this checkout. The previous escalated repair is already
present. Address the complete prior review report below, including its
residual missing length guard at src/frame.ts:21. Verify findings against
the code; explain any finding you decline with concrete evidence.

This is an in-place repair, not a new wave or isolated fan-out.

## Previous review report
${ESCALATED_CR_REPORT}

## Status protocol
${STATUS_PROTOCOL}

Return explicitly one of:
DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | NEEDS_CONTEXT | BLOCKED.

DONE means implemented, scoped tests pass, and self-review is complete.
Report one evidence line for the scoped command: met (exit 0, quoting the
last output line) or unmet with the reason. Report the task's via: evidence
and any unmet test-contract item; any unmet item requires DONE_WITH_CONCERNS.
`
})
```

Under the supplied observations, the parent receives `DONE`. Run the scoped gate:

```bash
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test frame.test.mjs)
```

Stage deliverables and record the first funded review tree, keyed to this wave:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" add -A || exit 1

CR_TREE_FUNDED_1=$(
  FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
  FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
  cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
  FD_STATUS=$?
  rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
  exit "$FD_STATUS"
) || exit 1
printf 'wave task-3 funded-review-1 tree: %s\n' "$CR_TREE_FUNDED_1"

FIX_DELTA_1=$(git -C "/workspace/project" diff --binary "$CR_TREE_ESCALATED" "$CR_TREE_FUNDED_1") || exit 1
```

The fixed observation guarantees a nonempty tracked delta. A tree-capture error would stop dispatch instead.

### First funded CR re-review

`Behaviour-change: no` means CR only. The review source remains the **entire integrated wave against the original wave base**, with the literal `WORKTREE`; the delta is additional repair context.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Review the integrated Task 3 wave for production readiness using the
code-reviewer template. Read code and git state; do not edit files.
Run only the listed scoped command if executing tests.

DESCRIPTION:
Task 3, Validate frame, including funded repair 1. The parent scoped gate
passed under the supplied observation.

PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS:
${TASK_3_TEXT}

Spec anchors:
${SPEC_ANCHORS}

BASE_SHA: ${WAVE_BASE_SHA}
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

Review the complete staged and unstaged integrated checkout against
BASE_SHA, not merely the fix delta and not a new commit range.

Check code quality, architecture, error handling, testing, requirements,
plan deviations, production readiness, clear file responsibilities,
independent testability, and change-contributed file growth.
Return the code-reviewer report format, including Verdict:,
Parallel-safe:, and Behaviour-change:.

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
${ESCALATED_CR_REPORT}

## Fix delta
${FIX_DELTA_1}

If your task contains a "Previous review report (re-review trigger)" section
and you found issues, append exactly one more line after Behaviour-change:
— this line, not Behaviour-change:, is the true final line of the report:

TRAJECTORY: CONVERGING (<n_prev> -> <n_now>, max severity <X>)
TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING
TRAJECTORY: STAGNANT (repeat of: <finding>)

Pick the first label that applies, in this order:
1. STAGNANT: a previous Critical or Moderate finding survives materially
   unchanged — name it.
2. DIVERGING: <n_now> >= <n_prev>, or the fix introduced a new Critical
   or Moderate finding.
3. CONVERGING: otherwise — the Critical/Moderate count fell, no new
   Critical or Moderate appeared, and every surviving Critical or Moderate
   was materially improved.

<n_prev>/<n_now> count Critical and Moderate findings only. Minors,
including outside-fix-delta downgrades, never move the TRAJECTORY line.
<X> is the highest remaining severity, using Critical/Moderate/Minor.

The orchestrator dispatches one extra ordinary fix only when this line
says CONVERGING without "max severity Critical"; be accurate, not generous.
If you found no issues, report success as usual and omit this line.
First reviews without a previous-report section omit this line.
`
})
```

Consume the supplied terminal report: `FIX_FIRST`, `Behaviour-change: no`, and `TRAJECTORY: CONVERGING (3 -> 1, max severity Moderate)`. Preserve that **complete report** as `FUNDED_1_CR_REPORT`.

One funded round is spent. Because this report is issue-bearing, is not `STAGNANT`, and one funded round remains, dispatch funded round 2. Do not commit or complete task 3.

## 3. Wave commit, then tracker completion

Only after the supplied second re-review accepts the integrated wave, fold all wave work into its durable commit:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA" &&
git -C "/workspace/project" add -A &&
git -C "/workspace/project" commit -m "Validate frame" ||
exit 1

git -C "/workspace/project" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all
```

An empty or failed commit stops progression; task 3 must not be completed. With a successful durable wave commit and a clean checkout, dispatch:

```ts
plan_tracker({
  action: "update",
  index: 3,
  status: "complete"
})
```

**Boundary:** stop after task 3’s wave commit and tracker completion. Do not start verification, whole-diff review, conformance, or finishing in this scenario.
